desc: Implement Node class with __slots__ for value, priority, left, right, size.
Implement update(node) to recompute size from children.
Implement split(node, k) returning (left, right) where left has first k elements.
Implement merge(left, right) returning combined treap maintaining heap property on priority.
Implement inorder(node, result_list) to collect values in order.
Read N and list P using sys.stdin.buffer.
For i in 1..N: create node, split root at P_i, merge left+node+right, update root.
Traverse final treap in-order to get final array.
Set sys.setrecursionlimit(1_000_000) and use random priorities.
